title: Saving an entry that was deleted in another tab shows Part Library entry not found
custom_preconds: • An unused Part Library entry (Delete enabled), safe to delete.
custom_steps:
1. Open the entry's Edit Library Part window in two browser tabs.
  2. In tab 1 click Delete, confirm "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?".
  3. In tab 2 change the description and click Save.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • Toast "Library part deleted successfully."

Step 3:

  • One toast "Part Library entry not found." with "Please try to resolve this."; the dialog stays open; nothing is recreated.
